title: What If You Could See in Complete Darkness?

shots.line: The whole street goes dark at once, and you just keep walking.
shots.scene: SHOWCASE (S_showcase.js, done): medium tracking shot, HERO walks (walkAlong, s 1.95) along the night street; on 'dark' the lamps and windows die house by house (street power 1->0), 5 bystanders with signature colours switch on phone torches; HERO keeps walking, smirks on 'walking'.

shots.line: Round the coffee table, over the shoe, past the door that always eats your knee.
shots.scene: Dark apartment, side-on follow cam: the first ~0.8 s is the NORMAL pitch-dark view (moonlight rim only, HERO silhouette), then on 'Round' a quick dip/flash switches to the hero's THERMAL VIEW (thermalView, bright violet room): HERO's POV glides round the coffee table (cool violet), the lone shoe pops on 'shoe' (crosshair snaps to it), and the half-open door edge slides past on 'door' (cold purple, the HUD chip 'Door: dodged' pops). Camera keeps moving (camMove x). Keep the HUD brackets + palette bar.

shots.line: Your little sister Mina stumbles in, phone torch first. "How are you DOING this?"
shots.scene: SHOWCASE (S_showcase.js, done): Mina stumbles in phone-torch first (walkAlong kid), HERO turns, torch beam sweeps up to Biscuit on the fridge (eyeshine, then offended); Mina's talk starts on 'How'.

shots.line: she asks, and you shrug, because honestly, you have no idea.
shots.scene: GIANT FACE HERO (giantFace r 320) lit cold-white from screen-left by Mina's phone torch (rimSide -1, rimColor '#e8f0ff'), blurred dark apartment behind. faceAt: neutral -> sheepish on 'shrug' (head tilts, shoulders of the hood rise) -> cheeky half-smile on 'idea'. Blink, breath, slow push-in.

shots.line: You can see the mouse by the bin and the toast going cold.
shots.scene: SHOWCASE (S_showcase.js, done): thermal view of the kitchen: big white-yellow mouse by the bin, toast fading white -> orange from 'toast', Biscuit loafed on the fridge, crosshair + temp readout.

shots.line: Biscuit the cat blinks down at you from the fridge like you've insulted her.
shots.scene: Low-angle creature insert: BISCUIT (cat s 2.6, pose 'sit', purple collar) on top of the fridge, moon rim, green eyeshine. Slow blink on 'blinks', ears swivel, then eyes:'offended' half-lid stare down at camera on 'insulted'; tail flicks over the fridge edge. Fridge magnets/art in frame, blurred pendant lamp foreground.

shots.line: And you still can't find your phone charger. So,
shots.scene: Thermal insert of the side table (pos.chargerX): HERO's glowing hands (heatActor arms / heatBlob hands ~0.9) pat around a cold purple tabletop; the charger brick and cable are invisible (draw nothing). HUD chip 'CHARGER: NOT FOUND'. Cut to HERO's thermal head shaking on 'charger'.

shots.line: what if you could see in complete darkness? Stay with me,
shots.scene: TITLE CARD: 'WHAT IF YOU COULD SEE IN COMPLETE DARKNESS?' (UI.titleCard) over the night skyline that warms into thermal colours behind the letters; slow push, stars + dust, glow on the title. Hold through 'Stay with me'.

shots.line: because there are five rules, and the fifth one decides whether you find her.
shots.scene: Five gold rule tokens (big extruded numerals 1-5 like ruleCard) drop in one by one along a dark shelf on 'five rules'; on 'fifth' token 5 rattles and its glow turns into a single tiny white spark; on 'her' the spark pulses and Mina's red-scarf silhouette flickers behind it in the rain. Camera drifts toward token 5.

shots.line: Rule one. Before any new powers, your old eyes quit first.
shots.scene: SHOWCASE (S_showcase.js, done): RULE 1 'YOUR EYES QUIT FIRST' lock-up over the audience hall.

shots.line: They've got about one hundred and twenty million rods for the dark
shots.scene: SHOWCASE (S_showcase.js, done): blueprint eye draws on, gold labels, dashed zoom into the rods inset, chip 'About 120 million rods' on 'million'.

shots.line: and about six million cones for colour,
shots.scene: Blueprint continues: camera slides along the BP.retina inset (rods + cones true); the tapered cones light up in a gold wave on 'six'. Gold chip 'About 6 million cones' on 'million', label 'CONES = COLOUR' pops on 'colour'.

shots.line: and at night, the cones basically clock out.
shots.scene: Blueprint retina at night: BP.retina dim 0->1 so the cones fade to grey one by one on 'clock out' while the rods stay lit; a tiny gold punch-clock icon stamps 'OFF DUTY' (chip 'Cones: off duty', coral). Slow 3% scale.

shots.line: That sounds fine, until you walk out of sunshine
shots.scene: Cinema lobby (cinema view 'lobby', door 1 = blazing daylight doorway behind). HERO (s 1.9) walks in from the daylight (walkAlong), relaxed smirk, sunglasses-pushed-up attitude; rim is warm daylight. Camera tracks with him toward the dark hall entrance.

shots.line: into a cinema and can't see a thing.
shots.scene: GIANT FACE HERO in the pitch-black hall: only the flickering blue screen rim on one side (rimSide 1, rimColor '#7fa8ff'). faceAt: neutral -> squint on 'can't' -> worried on 'thing', eyes searching left/right (look). Heavy vignette (darkness k 0.6 with a clear spot on the face).

shots.line: Your rods need twenty to thirty minutes to catch up.
shots.scene: Blueprint: BP.retina rods slowly refill with light (flood 0 -> 0.6) while a gold clock dial sweeps beside them; gold chip '20-30 minutes' on 'twenty', label 'DARK ADAPTATION'.

shots.line: Your best mate Dev shuffles in, orange beanie on,
shots.scene: Cinema hall, dark, projector beam overhead: DEV (s 1.9, orange beanie, popcorn tub prop) shuffles in from the aisle steps with arms out like a zombie (walkAlong slow), confused (exprAt confused -> worried on 'beanie'); aisle step lights, row letters, audience heads in varied colours, blurred seat-back foreground.

shots.line: popcorn flying. "Where's row F?"
shots.scene: Medium on DEV: he catches a step, popcorn arcs up through the projector beam (FX particles, lit gold in the beam), he flails (reaction 'shock'); on 'Where's' he talks (talk: talkAmount) 'Where's row F?' with a pleading face, popcorn still raining.

shots.line: he groans, and you walk him straight to it.
shots.scene: Thermal view of the cinema hall (cinema as cold set): DEV glowing orange-white groping in the aisle, HERO (heatActor) calmly takes his sleeve and walks him to the row F sign (pos.rowFX), audience heads glow as warm dots; HUD crosshair on Dev, chip 'ROW F'.

shots.line: A cat needs roughly a sixth of the light you do,
shots.scene: Blueprint: side-by-side human eye and cat eye (slit pupil, tapetum glow) with two light meters; the cat's meter fills at only one sixth; gold chip '1/6 of the light' on 'sixth'.

shots.line: but even a cat is helpless in true darkness.
shots.scene: Creature insert in a truly pitch-black apartment (darkness k 0.85, only a thin moon rim): BISCUIT (cat s 2.4, pose 'stand', walk) pads forward with eyes:'wide', bumps her nose into a sofa cushion on 'helpless', sits down eyes:'offended'. Contact shadow, rim on fur.

shots.line: And humans aren't hopeless. In a 2016 experiment,
shots.scene: Lab with lights 0.2: a VOLUNTEER (plain ink figure, one signature colour '#2f6fd0' hoodie, s 1.9) sits in a dark booth with chin rest and a button; HERO (s 1.85) watches beside the tripod. Gold chip '2016' pops on '2016'; volunteer gives a hopeful thumbs-up on 'hopeless'.

shots.line: volunteers spotted single photons,
shots.scene: Macro on the volunteer's eye in the dark booth: a single photon (BP.photon style gold dot with trail) zips in on 'single', the pupil twitches, finger presses the button (click) on 'photons'.

shots.line: the tiniest bits of light, a little better than chance.
shots.scene: Blueprint: one photon hits one rod in BP.retina, the rod flashes gold and the signal travels to the nerve cells; a score bar edges just past a 'CHANCE' line on 'better'; gold chip 'A little better than chance'.

shots.line: Upside, no more stubbed toes.
shots.scene: Foot-level insert in the dark apartment: HERO's foot glides neatly over a table leg and a stray toy brick (moon rim), lands softly; a green chip 'UPSIDE' (tone blue) pops on 'Upside'. Camera slides with the foot.

shots.line: Downside, Dev wants to know why you keep staring at him in the dark.
shots.scene: Two-shot in the dark cinema row: DEV (popcorn) slowly turns his head, finds HERO staring straight at him in the dark (HERO eyes with a faint orange glint); Dev freezes mid-chew, exprAt neutral -> suspicious on 'staring'; coral chip 'DOWNSIDE' on 'Downside'.

shots.line: Fair question, honestly.
shots.scene: GIANT FACE DEV (giantFace who 'DEV') lit by the blue screen flicker: faceAt suspicious -> squint, one popcorn kernel stuck on the beanie, slow push; HERO's glinting eyes reflected as two tiny orange dots in Dev's pupils.

shots.line: So how do you see where nothing shines?
shots.scene: Pitch-black apartment (darkness k 0.8 with a clear spot): HERO (s 1.9) silhouette with moon rim raises an open hand and studies it, head tilted (exprAt neutral -> curious/squint on 'nothing shines'); dust in the moon shaft, window skyline dark.

shots.line: Easy: nothing has to shine. Everything's already glowing.
shots.scene: SHOWCASE (S_showcase.js, done): GIANT FACE HERO searching -> double take -> SHOCKED on 'everything's' -> DELIGHTED with orange heat glow on 'glowing', sparkles.

shots.line: That's rule two. The dark isn't empty.
shots.scene: RULE 2 card 'THE DARK ISN'T EMPTY' (ruleCard n 2) over the dark apartment drawn dim, with faint warm thermal glows (sofa, cat on the fridge) breathing behind the banner.

shots.line: Anything warmer than absolute zero glows with infrared.
shots.scene: Blueprint: BP.wavelength chart draws on; a thermometer drops to 'ABSOLUTE ZERO -273 C' (gold) and everything above it gets a red infrared glow wave; label 'INFRARED' pops on 'infrared'.

shots.line: Your couch, your cat, you.
shots.scene: Thermal pan across the living room: warm sofa cushion where someone sat (heatRect 0.5) on 'couch', BISCUIT curled on the arm (heatCat) on 'cat', then HERO (heatActor, s 1.9) brightest of all on 'you', crosshair hopping to each with a temp readout.

shots.line: Dr. Lin, in her green lanyard, kills every light in the lab
shots.scene: Lab, lights on: DR LIN (s 1.9, white coat, round glasses, green lanyard) grins at the wall switch; on 'kills' she slaps it and the ceiling strips die one by one (lab lights 1 -> 0), only the blueprint wall and monitor glow remain; HERO on the right of frame looks up.

shots.line: and tells you to hold up a hand. You count five warm fingers.
shots.scene: Thermal insert: HERO's raised hand (heatBlob palm + 5 finger heatRects, skin 0.9) against the violet lab; fingers count up with gold numerals 1-5 popping, final big gold '5' on 'five'; HUD crosshair on the palm '34 C'.

shots.line: "Not magic," she whispers, thrilled. "Physics."
shots.scene: Dark lab lit only by the thermal monitor glow (orange) from below: DR LIN close medium (s 2.1) leans in whispering 'Not magic' (talk), finger to lips, then beams 'Physics!' with a thrilled grin and a little fist pump on 'Physics'. Green lanyard catches the light.

shots.line: Human skin glows most strongly near nine and a half micrometres,
shots.scene: Blueprint: BP.wavelength with peak 9.5; the human skin curve draws on and its peak lights up; gold label '9.5 micrometres' with a leader line on 'nine'.

shots.line: and thermal cameras read exactly that.
shots.scene: Insert on the lab tripod thermal camera: its monitor shows a crisp thermal image of DR LIN waving (heatActor in a monitor-sized thermalView); HUD reticle locks on 'exactly'.

shots.line: Your eyes can't, and one reason is that they're warm too.
shots.scene: Blueprint: BP.eye with glowK rising so the eye itself glows warm; IR rays from outside get lost in the eye's own glow; chip 'Your eyes glow too' (coral) on 'warm'.

shots.line: It's like reading a dim screen with a torch in your face.
shots.scene: Gag two-shot in the dark apartment: HERO squints at a very dim phone screen while DEV shines a torch right into his face (FX.lightCone + glow from Dev's hand); HERO winces (reaction 'wince') on 'face', Dev grinning.

shots.line: Nature found a workaround. A pit viper has a hollow pit
shots.scene: Night forest (forest view 'cave', moonlight): PIT VIPER (snake len 220, s 2.2) coiled on a mossy rock, tongue flicking; camera pushes in to its face and a gold ring highlights the hollow heat pit between eye and nostril on 'pit'.

shots.line: on its face that works like a pinhole camera for heat,
shots.scene: Blueprint: pinhole-camera diagram of the pit organ: heat rays from a small mouse outline pass through the narrow pit opening and form an upside-down warm image on the membrane; label 'PINHOLE CAMERA FOR HEAT'.

shots.line: and in 2010 scientists traced its heat sensor
shots.scene: Blueprint zoom into the pit membrane: nerve endings light up; gold chip '2010' on '2010', label 'HEAT SENSOR' on 'sensor'.

shots.line: to a protein called TRPA1.
shots.scene: Blueprint molecule cartoon: a channel protein in the membrane opens like a gate when a red heat wave hits it, ions flow; gold label 'TRPA1' pops on 'TRPA1'.

shots.line: So a snake can find a mouse in total darkness.
shots.scene: Thermal forest floor: the snake is cold purple (heatSnake 0.3) except its two hot pit organs; a bright white-yellow mouse (heatMouse s 5) sniffs nearby; the snake's head turns toward the mouse on 'find' (crosshair locks).

shots.line: You can find a mouse... and, finally, the remote.
shots.scene: Thermal living room: HERO (heatActor) lifts a sofa cushion, a glowing mouse scurries out on 'mouse'; then he plucks out a warm-ish remote (heatRect 0.5, warm from being sat on) and holds it up triumphant on 'remote'; HUD chip 'REMOTE FOUND'.

shots.line: Out on the dark street, you spot a small orange glow
shots.scene: Thermal street (street power 0 as cold set): violet facades and a cold parked car; HERO (heatActor) walks into frame; under the car (pos.carX) a small orange glow pulses on 'glow'; crosshair slides to it, temp '38 C'.

shots.line: under a parked car and rescue a kitten.
shots.scene: Normal dark street (power 0, moon + one lit window): HERO (s 1.9) crouches by the parked car, reaches under and lifts out a tiny KITTEN (cat collar null, s 1.4, eyes wide, mew) on 'kitten', cradles it; HERO smiles.

shots.line: Then you walk face first into a shop window,
shots.scene: Medium tracking: HERO walks along the shop front holding the kitten (walkAlong), confident, and on 'window' smacks face-first into the corner shop window (pos.shopX): punch zoom + shake, glass shudders, the neon OPEN sign flickers, kitten blinks.

shots.line: because ordinary glass blocks thermal infrared.
shots.scene: Blueprint: a glass pane cross-section; visible light rays (cream) pass straight through, thermal IR rays (red wavy lines) bounce off on 'blocks'; label 'GLASS BLOCKS THERMAL IR'.

shots.line: To you, it's a flat, cold wall.
shots.scene: Thermal POV of the shop window: the warm shop interior is completely hidden behind a flat even purple wall (glass draws nothing hot); only a faint mirror-reflection of HERO's own heat shimmers in it; chip 'COLD WALL' on 'wall'.

shots.line: Dev wheezes. "Mate, that was a window.
shots.scene: Street medium: DEV (s 1.9) doubled over laughing by the shop, pointing (talk: 'Mate, that was a window.'), HERO in the background rubbing his nose, kitten peeking out of the mustard hoodie.

shots.line: Ten out of ten."
shots.scene: GIANT FACE DEV joy (laughing, tears of laughter) under the neon OPEN glow (rimColor '#ff6a8a'); a gold '10/10' stamp slams in beside him on 'Ten', punch zoom + shake.

shots.line: Rule three. Heat has no colour.
shots.scene: RULE 3 card 'HEAT HAS NO COLOUR' (ruleCard n 3) over the kitchen table drawn dim, a blank birthday card on the table catching the banner glow.

shots.line: Mina slides a birthday card across the table, and in the dark it's a
shots.scene: Apartment kitchen table, dark (moonlight + Mina's phone on the table as key): MINA (s 2.1, kid) slides a colourful birthday card across the table to HERO with a cheeky grin; HERO leans in.

shots.line: blank, warm rectangle, because ink and paper are the same temperature.
shots.scene: Thermal insert of the card in HERO's warm hands: the card is one blank, evenly warm rectangle (heatRect 0.5), no text at all; chip 'Ink = paper = same temp' on 'same temperature'.

shots.line: You guess "happy birthday."
shots.scene: HERO medium, holding the card up proudly in the dark, confident smile; gold chip 'Happy birthday?' pops on 'happy'.

shots.line: It says "get well soon."
shots.scene: GIANT FACE HERO lit by Mina's phone torch (rimSide -1): faceAt cheeky -> sheepish on 'get well soon' with sweat drop; the card raised beside his face now readable: 'GET WELL SOON' with a bandaged cartoon.

shots.line: Then she tucks a hand warmer into your hoodie pocket.
shots.scene: Two-shot: MINA (kid) tucks a small hand warmer brick (glowing faint orange) into HERO's mustard hoodie pocket; HERO looks down surprised (lookToward).

shots.line: "Keep it," she says, "I've got the twin."
shots.scene: MINA medium (s 2.2): talk 'Keep it... I've got the twin', holds up her own identical hand warmer with a cheeky wink (exprAt smile -> cheeky on 'twin'); fairy lights bokeh behind.

shots.line: To you, it burns like a tiny coal. Hold on to that.
shots.scene: MOTIF PLANT: thermal close on the hoodie pocket: the hand warmer is a white-hot spark (heatRect 1.0 with heatBlob halo) glowing through the fabric like a tiny coal; slow push-in, shimmer on 'Hold on to that'.

shots.line: Night-vision goggles amplify faint light that's already there,
shots.scene: Blueprint: night-vision goggle cutaway (image intensifier tube): a few photons in on the left, a shower of green photons out on the right on 'amplify'; label 'AMPLIFIES EXISTING LIGHT'.

shots.line: so in true darkness, they've got nothing.
shots.scene: Pitch-black room seen through green goggle view (local green tint overlay + noise): DEV wearing NV goggles sees only grainy black, arms out, bumps into the bookcase on 'nothing'; chip 'NO LIGHT = NOTHING'.

shots.line: Thermal wins the pitch black, but only for warm things.
shots.scene: Split frame: left half green-goggle black noise, right half thermal: HERO and Biscuit glow brightly, a cold mug stays purple; divider wipes left on 'Thermal wins'; chip 'Only warm things' on 'warm'.

shots.line: Colour is a much bigger ask. In 2004,
shots.scene: Blueprint colour wheel draws on with a big gold question mark; then flips to a field note card: gold '2004' on '2004'.

shots.line: helmet geckos told blue from grey at about moonlight levels.
shots.scene: Moonlit rock macro: HELMET GECKO (gecko s 3) with big golden eye between a blue card and a grey card; it turns its head and taps the blue one on 'blue'; chip 'Blue vs grey, by moonlight'.

shots.line: You? Hot, warm, cold. That's your whole palette.
shots.scene: Thermal medium of HERO shrugging (heatActor shrug pose); the HUD palette bar collapses to just three swatches labelled HOT / WARM / COLD popping on each word; chip 'Your whole palette'.

shots.line: Upside, you win hide and seek forever.
shots.scene: Thermal living room: DEV glows bright behind the curtain and the sofa (only his legs hidden), HERO points straight at him (pointAndLook) with a smirk; chip 'UPSIDE' (blue).

shots.line: Downside, you can't read a menu.
shots.scene: Cinema lobby (view 'lobby'): HERO squints at the blank menu board (pos.menuX) that is just flat even rectangles to him, DEV beside reading it happily with popcorn; coral chip 'DOWNSIDE'.

shots.line: Rule four: light is now your enemy.
shots.scene: RULE 4 card 'LIGHT IS THE ENEMY' (ruleCard n 4) over the midnight street drawn dim, one sodium lamp flaring behind the banner.

shots.line: You step off the kerb at midnight, and a cyclist with no lamp
shots.scene: Midnight street, near-dark (power 0.15): HERO and DEV step off the kerb (pos.kerbY) together, chatting; on 'cyclist' a dark unlit cyclist shape rushes in from frame left, barely visible.

shots.line: glows like a ghost. You yank Dev back.
shots.scene: Thermal street: the cyclist streaks across as a glowing white-orange ghost (heatActor + warm wheel hubs), motion trail; HERO grabs DEV's sleeve and yanks him back on 'yank' (reaction).

shots.line: "How did you SEE that?" Dev asks.
shots.scene: GIANT FACE DEV shocked (faceAt shocked, mouth open keys for 'How did you SEE that?'), lit by a cold street rim; sweat drop, punch-in on 'SEE'.

shots.line: And right then, the cyclist's lamp snaps on.
shots.scene: Street medium: the cyclist stopped up the road turns; on 'snaps' his head lamp clicks on straight at camera: FX.lensStreak + big glow + lightCone toward HERO and DEV.

shots.line: One bright flash, your thermal view whites out,
shots.scene: Thermal view whites out: whiteOut k ramps 0 -> 1 on 'flash', HUD glitches and the palette bar burns out on 'whites out'; hold blinding white with a faint silhouette.

shots.line: and your old eyes aren't ready either. Total blindness.
shots.scene: GIANT FACE HERO in white glare: faceAt shocked -> squint, eyes screwed shut, hand shielding (blurred), image fading toward white-grey on 'Total blindness'; slow shake.

shots.line: Bright light floods your rods, which normally need twenty to thirty minutes to recover.
shots.scene: Blueprint BP.retina flood 0 -> 1 on 'floods' (rods drowned in white), gold chip '20-30 minutes' on 'twenty', label 'RECOVERY'.

shots.line: Your new sight takes about a minute, a long, shaky minute,
shots.scene: Thermal view rebooting: wobbling, smeared, slowly regaining contrast from white; HUD 'RECALIBRATING' with a gold '~1 minute' chip on 'minute'; camera sways.

shots.line: with Dev leading you home by the sleeve.
shots.scene: Street two-shot: DEV leads HERO home by the sleeve (both walkAlong), HERO's eyes shut, free arm groping; Dev patient-smug.

shots.line: It's amazing and awful, usually both at once.
shots.scene: Apartment sofa, warm lamp on (power 1): HERO with an ice pack over his eyes, Biscuit on his lap; expression flips delighted -> wince on 'awful' -> lopsided smirk on 'both'.

shots.line: So remember: dark is your friend,
shots.scene: Blueprint: a crescent moon icon draws on with gold label 'DARK = FRIEND' on 'friend'.

shots.line: light is a punch. You're about to need that.
shots.scene: A torch beam punches into the lens (FX.lightCone + whiteOut flash 0.2), label 'LIGHT = PUNCH' (coral) on 'punch'; then hard cut to a rainy dark forest with thunder flicker on 'need that' (foreshadow).

shots.line: Which brings us to rule five. Cold things hide.
shots.scene: RULE 5 card 'COLD THINGS HIDE' (ruleCard n 5) over the rainy forest camp drawn dim; rain streaks in front of the banner.

shots.line: School camping trip, rain pouring through the trees,
shots.scene: Establishing wide (<= 3 s), forest view 'camp': tents, dead fire, log seats, lantern, heavy rain (rain true); small group of classmates with torches by the tents, HERO in mustard >= 12% of frame height, camera booms down through the pines.

shots.line: and Mina is gone. You scan the forest.
shots.scene: Medium at the empty second tent (pos.tent2X): MINA's red scarf left on a log; HERO (s 1.95) turns from it worried on 'gone', then turns to scan the dark trees determined on 'scan' (lookToward). Rain, blurred fern foreground.

shots.line: A deer, a fox, Dev glowing beside you.
shots.scene: Thermal forest pan: a DEER (heatDeer, graze) on 'deer', a FOX (heatFox) on 'fox', then DEV (heatActor) bright beside HERO on 'Dev'; the crosshair hops to each with a temp chip. Rain drawn cool.

shots.line: Everything alive shows up, except her. Why?
shots.scene: Thermal sweep across rocks and the cave mouth: everything alive lights up but the crosshair finds no match; HUD 'NO MATCH' blinks coral on 'her'; on 'Why?' the camera stops on the grey rock face.

shots.line: Because the rain has soaked everything cold,
shots.scene: Thermal: heavy rain streaks wash across the scene; temperature readouts on rocks/trees count down; everything shifts toward one even violet-grey.

shots.line: warm and cool fade into the same grey.
shots.scene: Blueprint: two heat swatches (warm orange, cool violet) slide together on 'fade' and merge into one flat grey square; label 'SAME GREY'.

shots.line: Her skin is cool, and she's blending into the rock.
shots.scene: Thermal close on the rock ledge (pos.ledgeX): a barely visible curled small shape (heatActor MINA kid, heat 0.35) almost the same colour as the rock; very slow push; HUD temp drops to '22 C'; nothing marked.

shots.line: Ranger Tomas, in his blue cap, shouts that it's hopeless,
shots.scene: Forest camp medium: RANGER TOMAS (s 1.9, blue cap, olive tracksuit) shouts into the rain (talk while 'shouts that it's hopeless'), torch in hand, despairing gesture; HERO and DEV behind, rain, lantern glow.

shots.line: and swings his torch at a cave mouth.
shots.scene: Over-the-shoulder from behind HERO (blurLayer foreground hood at 1.6): TOMAS swings his torch beam (FX.lightCone) across the trees to the cave mouth (forest view 'cave', torch 1, torchAngle animating) on 'cave'.

shots.line: The light slams into your eyes, everything goes white, and you're blind again.
shots.scene: Thermal view of the cave mouth: the torch beam sweeps into lens and slams the view to white on 'slams' (whiteOut 0 -> 1, HUD burns out), hold white; on 'blind again' the white sinks to a dim grey with HERO's silhouette. Climax: give it the full length.

shots.line: And now, a choice. Run in blind, or wait in the dark?
shots.scene: GIANT FACE HERO in the rain, eyes shut (faceAt squint -> determined on 'wait'), rain drops on the hood, cold moon rim; two chips pop either side: 'RUN IN BLIND' (coral) on 'Run' and 'WAIT IN THE DARK' (gold) on 'wait'. Slow push.

shots.line: Mina is cold, and every minute matters.
shots.scene: Under the rock ledge, dark (moon rim only): MINA (kid, s 2.1) curled up in her coat, shivering (sin jitter), breath puffs, red scarf gone; rain curtain in front.

shots.line: "Lights out," you croak. "Everybody."
shots.scene: Three-shot in the rain: HERO raises a flat hand (stop gesture) and SAYS his quoted line: talk: talkAmount(info.globalT, wordTime('Lights')-.05, wordTime('Everybody')+.6), low croak (small mouth). TOMAS and DEV turn to him (lookToward) on 'Lights', Tomas's torch still on.

shots.line: Tomas clicks off his torch. So you wait.
shots.scene: Insert: TOMAS's thumb clicks the torch switch on 'clicks', the beam dies (lightCone fades), frame drops to three moon-rimmed silhouettes in the rain.

shots.line: Sixty seconds, in the dark, listening to the rain.
shots.scene: Wait in the dark: three rim-lit silhouettes standing still in the rain (not black: moon rim, rain highlights, faint cave mouth), a gold '60' countdown ticks in the corner from 'Sixty'; very slow push.

shots.line: And slowly, the grey comes back. Rock. Rain.
shots.scene: Thermal view fades back from black: violet-grey forms reassemble, HUD reboots; crosshair labels 'ROCK' on 'Rock' and 'RAIN' on 'Rain'. Slow cut, give it room.

shots.line: And then, low down, one tiny white spark.
shots.scene: Thermal slow push down to the low rock ledge: one tiny white spark appears on 'spark' (heatRect 1.0 + halo), crosshair snaps to it, shimmer.

shots.line: A small hand pulling something out of a coat.
shots.scene: Thermal macro: a small cool hand (heat 0.45) pulls the white-hot hand warmer out of a coat pocket; the spark brightens and lights the fingers.

shots.line: Mina's hand warmer. The twin.
shots.scene: GIANT FACE HERO awe -> delighted, lit white-orange from below by his own twin hand warmer held beside his face (glint), rain on the hood; sparkles on 'twin'.

shots.line: You run to her. She's curled up under a rock ledge,
shots.scene: HERO runs (walkAlong fast) through the rain toward the rock ledge, camera following low; ferns whip past in the foreground; on 'ledge' Mina's curled shape revealed under the rock.

shots.line: cold and shivering, and smiling. "You found me," she mumbles.
shots.scene: Two-shot under the ledge: HERO kneels and wraps his mustard hoodie round MINA; she shivers then smiles on 'smiling' and mumbles 'You found me' (talk), the hand warmer glowing between them.

shots.line: And you say, "Of course I did."
shots.scene: GIANT FACE HERO, tender joy (faceAt neutral -> joy on 'Of'), and he SAYS 'Of course I did' (talk over those words only, giantFace talk param / talkAmount); warm glow from below (hand warmer), rain easing, soft sparkles.

shots.line: Dev cheers. Tomas wipes his eyes and blames the rain.
shots.scene: Three-shot at the ledge: DEV cheers with both arms up (reaction 'delight') on 'cheers'; TOMAS wipes his eyes with his sleeve, pointing at the sky on 'rain'; torch now pointed politely at the ground.

shots.line: Mina waves the little brick at you.
shots.scene: MINA medium wrapped in the mustard hoodie, waving the little hand warmer (glowing) at HERO with a cheeky grin.

shots.line: "Best twin ever," she says.
shots.scene: GIANT FACE MINA cheeky (faceAt worried -> cheeky -> joy, mouth keys for 'Best twin ever'), red scarf, warm glow, blink.

shots.line: "You owe me hot chocolate."
shots.scene: Wide-ish two-shot (still >= 25% height): HERO carries MINA piggyback toward the camp lantern, Mina talks 'You owe me hot chocolate' (talk), HERO rolls his eyes then smiles; two warm sparks glow.

shots.line: So, is any of this real?
shots.scene: Lab, lights on: DR LIN at the blueprint wall turns to camera, eyebrow raised; UI.bigLine 'IS ANY OF THIS REAL?' (the question) on 'real'.

shots.line: Pit vipers are. Thermal cameras are. Night-vision goggles are.
shots.scene: Checklist card (UI.dataCard style) with three icons: snake, thermal camera, NV goggles; a gold tick pops on each 'are'.

shots.line: Even spotting single photons is real, barely.
shots.scene: Blueprint: a single photon blip into the eye, tiny wobbling gold tick labelled 'barely' on 'barely'.

shots.line: But no human can see heat, goggles aren't eyes,
shots.scene: Blueprint: human eye vs IR wavelength band with a coral X on 'heat'; goggles outline with a coral X on 'aren't eyes'.

shots.line: and without light, cats and goggles are blind.
shots.scene: Pitch-black apartment comedy two-shot: DEV in NV goggles and BISCUIT both bump into the coffee table on 'blind'; Biscuit offended.

shots.line: You'd need infrared sensors, and a body that doesn't glow itself.
shots.scene: Blueprint: UI.lineFigure of HERO with IR sensor eyes (labelled 'IR SENSORS') and a cooled body shown in pale blue ('COOLED BODY') on 'body'.

shots.line: Are we close? Not yet.
shots.scene: Lab: DR LIN taps the blueprint wall and shakes her head with a smile; gold chip 'NOT YET' on 'Not'.

shots.line: The dark was never empty. It was only quiet.
shots.scene: Rooftop thermal wide of the city at night (street as cold set): windows, people and cats softly glowing; HERO silhouette (heatActor) sits at the edge, Biscuit beside; slow drift. Poetic hold.

shots.line: So what would you do if you could see in complete darkness?
shots.scene: GIANT FACE HERO turns to camera cheeky (faceAt neutral -> cheeky), eyes glint orange; the question line 'WHAT WOULD YOU DO?' (allowed text) glows beneath.

shots.line: Tell us in the comments. And if you'd trust that tiny white spark,
shots.scene: Freeze-frame: HERO and MINA hand in hand in silhouette at the edge of the forest, the white spark glowing between their hands; a comment bubble icon pops on 'comments'; slow drift.

shots.line: hit like, and subscribe for more What Ifs.
shots.scene: End screen (UI.endScreen): subscribe pill, like icon, whole cast lined up (HERO, MINA, DEV, LIN, TOMAS + Biscuit).
